headline: Worlds drawn
from folklore.
intro: I'm Matyáš Galda, a Game Design student at Tomas Bata University in Zlín. My concept art combines digital painting and photobashing with history, culture and impossible proportions.
heroAlt: Pencil-style drawing of an artist, seen from behind and to the side, sketching a spired castle on a large pad
about: I'm studying Game Design at the Faculty of Multimedia Communications, Tomas Bata University in Zlín. I like working with unrealistic proportions, folklore and technology, and I lean on cultures, history and historic events to make the imagined parts of my art feel real.
I work both on my own and in a team, and I pick up new tools quickly.
